citation: Chicagology, 'Wolf's Point and the Town of Chicago,' transcription/excerpt from A. T. Andreas, History of Chicago, identifying William Walters as proprietor of the Wolf Point Tavern, 1833-1836.
note: Modern access path to Andreas. The multi-year proprietor range corroborates Walters but is not treated as a direct July 1, 1835 address instrument.

transcribes.work: A. T. Andreas, History of Chicago, vol. 1
transcribes.note: Carries the Wolf Point Tavern proprietor chronology used for William Walters.
